description: Machine-readable companion contract for the first dual pea and soy internal benchmark package.

matrices.purpose: First quantitative PPI meaty-positive matrix benchmark under moderate aqueous heating.
First quantitative SPI benchmark capturing meaty generation and off-flavour suppression under high-severity heating.

analytical_requirements.thiol_quantification: thiol-specific derivatization plus an internal-standard route suitable for absolute quantification
analytical_requirements.aldehyde_quantification: calibrated quantification with hexanal-d12 or equivalent internal standard
analytical_requirements.safety_method: LC-MS/MS in the soy 120 C arm
required_metadata: exact pH before and after heating
